_about: v16.4 Inside C only: independent check of review-math.json (8) and review-user.json (10) against the running app (work/xvhs/dist/test.html, headless Chrome on port 9865), 2026-10-26. dist was first confirmed to be the build of the current src (a scratch rebuild is byte-identical). Not the ledger: each fix was re-run in the app. 'still_wrong' lists what is still wrong; 'checked' says how each finding was verified.

still_wrong.title: English captions: the new closing comma inside a nested phrase reads as a list break
still_wrong.detail: The closing comma ({pc}) is added in English too, and also when a seg line is named inside another shape's phrase (a meet, a glider, a perpendicular to a seg line). In an English list that comma before 'and' looks like the list's own last-item comma. The intersection then reads as two list items, and the sentence has two final 'and's. Russian is correct («…, проходящей через $z_0$ и~$z_1$, и~гиперболической прямой …»). Before the fix the English had no comma there and read correctly.
still_wrong.evidence: Scene: unit circle, z0 = 0.1+0.6i, z1 = -0.5-0.3i, z2 = 0.55-0.25i, seg lines k1 = (z0, z1) and k2 = (z1, z2), the meet of k1 and k2. Article caption (EN): '…, the intersection $z_{4}=-0.5-0.3i$ of the hyperbolic line through $z_{0}$ and $z_{1}$ in the domain $|z|<1$, and the hyperbolic line through $z_{1}$ and $z_{2}$ in the domain $|z|<1$, the point $z_{5}=0.2+0.1i$, the point $z_{6}=-0.1+0.3i$, and the circle through …'. The on-screen caption is the same.
still_wrong.fix: Close the phrase only where the language needs it: always in Russian; in English only at the end of the top-level list, before the template's 'in the $z$-plane'. Do not add {pc} to an English phrase used as a parameter of another phrase (construct.js CM and carrier through app.js capPhrase).

still_wrong.title: A hyperbolic triangle still draws with six tails: 'Between z0 and z1' is not built
still_wrong.detail: Still as reported. Inside draws the whole geodesic from C to C. The ledger defers it as a question for the user (SPEC 12), so it is not a fix that failed. It is open until the user answers.
still_wrong.evidence: J1 scene (three Inside sides through z0, z1, z2): each side runs to |z| = 1. review-user shots ru-tri-done.png and ru-exp2z.png still match the app.
still_wrong.fix: Ask the user the SPEC 12 question ('Also add Between z0 and z1, so a hyperbolic triangle draws without tails?') before v16.4 ships.

still_wrong.title: The triangle caption still says 'in the domain |z|<1' three times
still_wrong.detail: The 'in … in the z-plane' stacking is fixed ('…in the domain $|z|<1$, in the $z$-plane'). The repeated domain is not grouped, by choice (ledger). Still wordy for an article.
still_wrong.evidence: EN article caption of the J1 triangle: '…the hyperbolic line through $z_{0}$ and $z_{1}$ in the domain $|z|<1$, the hyperbolic line through $z_{1}$ and $z_{2}$ in the domain $|z|<1$, and the hyperbolic line through $z_{2}$ and $z_{0}$ in the domain $|z|<1$, in the $z$-plane.'

still_wrong.from: pre-existing in v16.3 (seen while checking; not caused by v16.4)
still_wrong.title: Homework captions rename the points A, B, C, … but construction phrases still say z0, z1; the 6th point is called F, the map's name
still_wrong.detail: In 'for: homework' the points are listed as A, B, C, …, but perpendicular circles and the new hyperbolic lines name their points as $z_{0}$, $z_{1}$. With six points, the sixth is 'F', the same letter as the map F in the same sentence. v16.3 does the same for a whole perpendicular circle, so this is not a v16.4 regression, but the new seg captions inherit it.
still_wrong.evidence: v16.4 RU homework: 'точка $A=0{,}1+0{,}6i$, … гиперболическая прямая в~области $|z|<1$, проходящая через $z_{0}$ и~$z_{1}$, … точка $F=0{,}2+0{,}1i$, … справа~--- образы при отображении $F$'. v16.3 (notes/v16.3-candidate) EN homework: 'the point $A=0.1+0.6i$, the point $B=-0.5-0.3i$, and the circle through $z_{0}$ and $z_{1}$ perpendicular to the circle $|z|=1$'.
still_wrong.fix: For the backlog: pass the letters map to Construct.phrase's point names in homework mode, and skip F (and the map's other letters) when assigning letters.

checked.math-1: fixed. In the app, Y under exp for the vertical seg ray Re z = 1 over the real axis draws a clean arc of |w| = e with no chords (shots/verify/vfy-exp-seg1.png; the image of X's visible part, as for a whole line). node test/t_constr.js: G 37/37, 288 passed.
checked.math-2: fixed. Seg ray with a glider at its infinite end (t 1, at inf): Whole circle gives t 0.5 at inf; One side of Line 1 only gives t 1 at inf. Whole diameter line with a glider at inf: Inside Circle 1 only moves it to the centre (mirror image, |p| = 8e-17); Other side brings it back to inf; Whole circle gives t 0.5 at inf.
checked.math-3: fixed. perp_cmd J2: '…in the domain $\{|z|>1\}\cup\{\infty\}$ on the circle through …'.
checked.math-4: fixed. 'Integrate F along it' (F = 1/z): the vertical seg ray gives 0.8047 + 1.1071i, which is log(1+2i), the integral from 1 to the window's top at 1+2i; the two rays give 0. No singularity message.

checked.math-6: fixed. perp_cmd J5: the item reads 'Outside the circle of Disc 1 only', and the row then says outside.

checked.math-8: documented only, as the ledger says (v16.2 and Preimage draw the two-rays case as the chord). Not re-run.
checked.user-2: fixed in Russian (perp_cmd J1, and a scene with a glider, a meet and a perpendicular to a seg line: every participial phrase is closed correctly, also in the homework caption). The English side effect is verify-1.
checked.user-4: fixed. 1440 EN: words once C is picked ('Point 1 of 2 · Orthogonal · Esc cancels | Whole | Inside'), chip right 663.5 inside the plane's 697; Whole's tooltip 'Whole: the whole circle'. 1440 RU: the words do not fit, so it shows icons, on one line inside the plane (chip right 669 of 697; shots/verify/vfy-chip-1440ru.png).
checked.user-5: fixed. perp_cmd J7 at 390 × 844 (Android, touch): both chips' buttons stay 20 px tall and take taps 18 px above and below their centre.
checked.user-6: fixed. perp_cmd J4 (EN and RU rows).
checked.user-7: not done (ledger: rejected; the reviewer called it optional). Still true: a seg K switched to Whole stays 'Arc n'.
checked.regressions: perp_cmd section J 9/9 with no console errors. Captions of all 40 examples (article, homework and on-screen; EN and RU) are the same as v16.3's. A first run showed a difference only in the phase-portrait examples 9, 11 and 12. It came from a namespace shared between the two pages. A re-run of EN examples 0–12 in fresh namespaces shows no difference. RU 9, 11 and 12 were not re-run. They showed the same phase-shading clause difference, which points to the same cause. No console errors in any probe.

not_checked: Deformation (morph) captions with seg lines: pcTidy runs in captionLatex and layoutCaption, but no morph figure was built.
The Orthogonal chip at 1024 px: the probe did not reach the chip (the tool's tile was not found at that width), so the words or icons choice there is unverified.
BUDGET60 and the quality suite were not re-run (the ledger's perp_cmd I8 reports frame p95 16.7 ms).
